items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: Or we'd be alternating with the late Henry Redd Allen.

ctx.x: He should be. He was at Nick's in the thirties. Oh, yeah. Mm-hmm. And uh, well, they went there before once, I think, with the Wolverine.

Right. Like I told you the other day, when we played Nick's in the Village, when I was with the Royal Alberta Bourbon Street Six, we did a lot of work at Nick's. And the first time we went there, looked in the window and they had pictures of Sharky. And in the window with his group, which was, I think, Monk Hadlen and Bill Bourgeois. And that was taken many, many years before, you know? And that picture was still in the window. So we did Nick's, oh, several times within about three or four year period. When we…
